### CHANNEL COPY

Subject: Men’s Nano Puff Jacket: packable warmth

Preheader: Lightweight, windproof, and easy to stash for everyday outings.

Body:
Meet the Men’s Nano Puff® Jacket, style 84212: a regular-fit layer built for cool days, windy walks, and travel-ready layering. It’s lightweight and highly compressible, so it packs down easily when you want a jacket that won’t take up much space.

The jacket is described as warm, windproof, and water-resistant. It uses a 100% recycled polyester ripstop shell with a DWR finish made without intentionally added PFAS, and PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco for low-bulk insulation. Practical details include a center-front zipper with an interior storm flap and chin zipper garage, two zippered handwarmer pockets, an internal zippered chest pocket that doubles as a stuffsack, and a drawcord-adjustable drop-tail hem.

For easy care, Patagonia lists machine wash warm, no bleach, tumble dry low, and no iron. Explore the product details to see whether it fits your everyday routine and outdoor plans.

Facts used:
- Product identified as Men’s Nano Puff® Jacket, style 84212, regular fit.
- Described as warm, windproof, water-resistant, lightweight, and highly compressible.
- Shell is 100% recycled polyester ripstop with a DWR finish made without intentionally added PFAS; water-resistant is not waterproof.
- Insulation is 60-g PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco made from 100% postconsumer recycled polyester, with P.U.R.E.™ technology.
- Listed features: brick quilting, center-front zipper with interior storm flap and chin zipper garage, two zippered handwarmer pockets, internal zippered chest pocket that doubles as a stuffsack, drawcord-adjustable drop-tail hem.
- Listed care instructions: machine wash warm; do not bleach; tumble dry low; do not iron.

Editorial interpretations:
- “Built for cool days, windy walks, and travel-ready layering” as a general use framing supported by the product’s warmth, windproofing, and packability.
- “Low-bulk insulation” and “packs down easily” as shorthand for lightweight, highly compressible, and stuffsack feature.
- “Everyday routine and outdoor plans” aligned with the campaign brief, not a sourced product claim.

Limitations / uncertainties:
- No prices, discounts, availability, or performance guarantees included.
- Avoided any unsupported environmental outcome claims.
- Did not mention repair/Worn Wear details in the body because they are general services and not necessary for the requested product introduction; repair eligibility and process can change.
